required_final_evidence: Every intended outcome and waiting control, bound original inputs, complete REST inventories and nine-table SQL reconciliation for cloud runs
deadline_bounds: Lower count: maximum completion count from a poll finished by the deadline. Upper count: minimum completion count from a poll started at or after the deadline, or the population if none exists. Keep the difference uncertain.
reset_policy: Only explicitly declared cloud cells with complete independently verified final state, stopped engine and verified owned cleanup; failed requests remain recorded and unknown outcomes never qualify.
scope: Finite-burst qualification and retrospective accounting. Not a performance, capacity or customer service-level claim.
